# Vendored dependencies

- `nlohmann/json.hpp`: nlohmann/json 3.11.3, MIT. Downloaded from https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3. License notice is included in the header.
- `httplib/httplib.h`: cpp-httplib 0.18.3, MIT. Downloaded from https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.3. License notice is included in the header.

These headers provide JSON parsing and HTTP transport. Graph algorithms are implemented independently in `src/domain/graph.hpp`. Frontend versions and font packages are pinned in `package-lock.json`; font packages include their upstream OFL licenses.
